setup.usage: Usage: taskspec setup | taskspec setup signing [--force] | taskspec setup decompose

setup signing.mutation: creates or explicitly rotates the repository-private HMAC key
setup signing.summary: creates or explicitly rotates the repository-private HMAC key

demo.mutation: creates and removes an isolated temporary repository
demo.summary: creates and removes an isolated temporary repository

example.mutation: writes one installed canonical example non-clobberingly; --force replaces and --dry-run writes nothing
example.summary:
writes one installed canonical example non-clobberingly; --force replaces and --dry-run writes nothing
Examples: task-plan, intent, recipe, incident, release-evidence. Use taskspec help example <kind>.

new.mutation: creates one Task-Spec scaffold and derived state
new.summary: creates one Task-Spec scaffold and derived state

batch.mutation: creates declared Task-Spec scaffolds; --dry-run writes nothing
batch.summary: creates declared Task-Spec scaffolds; --dry-run writes nothing

migrate.mutation: atomically upgrades one explicitly named legacy task under the task-state lock
migrate.summary: atomically upgrades one explicitly named legacy task under the task-state lock

gate.mutation: executes task evals; --stamp additionally writes the sign-off envelope
gate.summary: executes task evals; --stamp additionally writes the sign-off envelope

handoff.mutation: stdout is read-only; --out writes non-clobberingly unless --force
handoff.summary: stdout is read-only; --out writes non-clobberingly unless --force

run.mutation: runs declared eval commands in the task workspace
run.summary: runs declared eval commands in the task workspace

accept.mutation: executes acceptance evals; --stamp additionally writes AcceptanceRecord/v1 and the acceptance envelope
accept.summary: executes acceptance evals; --stamp additionally writes AcceptanceRecord/v1 and the acceptance envelope

holdout.mutation: seal/run may write descriptor or receipt; verify is read-only
holdout.summary: seal/run may write descriptor or receipt; verify is read-only

receipt.mutation: creator/sign commands write explicit receipt paths; validate is read-only
receipt.summary: creator/sign commands write explicit receipt paths; validate is read-only

eval-audit.mutation: uses temporary git worktrees; optional report path
eval-audit.summary: uses temporary git worktrees; optional report path

identity.mutation: init/sign/revoke write explicit files; verify is read-only
identity.summary: init/sign/revoke write explicit files; verify is read-only

evidence.mutation: run writes an explicit evidence directory; validate/plan are read-only
evidence.summary: run writes an explicit evidence directory; validate/plan are read-only

bridge.mutation: export writes only with --out; validate is read-only
bridge.summary: export writes only with --out; validate is read-only

dsse.mutation: export writes only to --out; verify is read-only
dsse.summary: export writes only to --out; verify is read-only

mesh.mutation: optional repository-local control plane; run/cancel/resume/accept/finish/setup mutate disposable mesh state while canonical acceptance still calls Task-Spec
mesh.usage: Usage: taskspec mesh <init|doctor|serve|frontier|run|status|watch|explain|cancel|resume|accept|finish|adapters|setup|mcp> ... | taskspec mesh run --initiative <id> [--execute]
mesh.summary: optional repository-local control plane; run/cancel/resume/accept/finish/setup mutate disposable mesh state while canonical acceptance still calls Task-Spec

graph.mutation: none; TaskGraphView/v1 is derived from Markdown and Git
graph.usage: Usage: taskspec graph [--task <id>] [--check] [--mermaid] [--json] | taskspec graph --initiative <id> --view tasks|capabilities
graph.summary: none; TaskGraphView/v1 is derived from Markdown and Git

status.mutation: none; emits TaskStatus/v1 and exactly one safe next command
status.summary: none; emits TaskStatus/v1 and exactly one safe next command

transition.mutation: changes lifecycle status and derived state
transition.summary: changes lifecycle status and derived state

archive.mutation: moves root done/parked tasks under the task-state lock and refreshes derived state
archive.summary: moves root done/parked tasks under the task-state lock and refreshes derived state

backup.mutation: writes a timestamped backlog archive to the selected destination
backup.summary: writes a timestamped backlog archive to the selected destination

executor.mutation: reference L2 executor; transitions, executes, accepts, or parks one supplied task
executor.summary: reference L2 executor; transitions, executes, accepts, or parks one supplied task

decompose.summary: Native intent decomposition, signed topology review, and TaskPlan compilation.
decompose.mutation: Native intent decomposition, signed topology review, and TaskPlan compilation.

recipe.summary: Inspect and validate resolved bounded execution guidance.

decompose prepare.summary: Validate and project an authored recipe; never approve it.
decompose prepare.mutation: Validate and project an authored recipe; never approve it.

decompose review.summary: Authenticate explicit approval of the current topology.
decompose review.mutation: Authenticate explicit approval of the current topology.

decompose compile.summary: Compile reviewed topology and lineage without sealing leaves.
decompose compile.mutation: Compile reviewed topology and lineage without sealing leaves.

decompose status.summary: Explain planning blockers and next valid action.

decompose impact.summary: Compare leaf projections to identify affected authorizations.

decompose import.summary: Explicitly import originals; fresh native review required.
decompose import.mutation: Explicitly import originals; fresh native review required.

setup decompose.summary: Provision locked dependencies in the private runtime.
setup decompose.mutation: Provision locked dependencies in the private runtime.

receipt operational.usage: Usage: taskspec receipt operational validate <file> | import <file> --out <path>
receipt operational.summary: Validate or import operational evidence without upgrading its trust.
receipt operational.mutation: Validate or import operational evidence without upgrading its trust.
